Buttermilk Pancakes

Makes about twelve, and the batter keeps overnight.

Ingredients

  • 250 g plain flour
  • 2 tsp baking powder
  • 350 ml buttermilk
  • 2 eggs
  • 1 tbsp caster sugar

Method

  1. Whisk the dry ingredients together.
  2. Beat the eggs into the buttermilk, then fold the two together.
  3. Cook ladlefuls in a buttered pan until the tops bubble & set.
